row.evidence: Miro's pricing comparison lists SCIM user provisioning as Not included on Free, Starter and Business and Included only on Enterprise (custom pricing, from 30 members); the SCIM API docs say it is available for Miro Enterprise accounts.
row.notes: Unchanged from June: SCIM is Enterprise-only (Contact Sales, from 30 members); Starter $8 and Business $20 per member/mo billed yearly. SAML SSO starts on Business, one tier below SCIM. SAML SSO must be working before SCIM is configured. IdP-initiated deletes are treated as deactivation (frees the licence); only direct DELETE calls remove a user. Google Workspace and OneLogin provisioning is users only (no group sync). Enterprise REST APIs (org members, teams, user groups, session reset, audit logs) are Enterprise-only; the basic REST API on all plans covers boards and board members, not org users.

auth.token_source: Company settings > Enterprise integrations > SCIM Provisioning > Generate new token

endpoints.notes: API reference lists ServiceProviderConfig, ResourceTypes, Schemas, Users and Groups; Bulk not supported.

deprovision.data_retained: Deactivated users keep their user group memberships and board ownership; a direct SCIM DELETE removes the user and transfers their boards to the oldest team admin.
deprovision.notes: Deactivated users lose access to the Enterprise subscription and cannot log in with SSO; an optional Block deactivated users setting also blocks other Miro subscriptions and logs them out.

filtering.notes: Operators eq, ne, co, sw, ew, pr, gt, ge, lt, le, and, or, not; sortBy/sortOrder supported.

pagination.notes: startIndex + count, default 100. ServiceProviderConfig example advertises filter maxResults 200 (see conflicts).

custom.how: Help centre says attributes beyond the listed ones are ignored.

roles.how: roles attribute: organization_user_role (ORGANIZATION_INTERNAL_ADMIN / ORGANIZATION_INTERNAL_USER) and organization_admin_role (Content Admin, User Admin, Security Admin, custom admin roles); licence via userType.

rate_limits.text: Per 30 seconds: GET Users 200, POST Users 200, PUT/PATCH Users 100, DELETE Users 20, GET Groups 5, GET Group 20, PATCH Groups 5 (>500 bytes) or 100; up to 8000 users per Group PATCH (413 above).

limitations.text: Bulk operations, password changes and ETags are not supported.
Delete events sent by an IdP are treated as deactivation; only direct API DELETE removes the user.
Google Workspace and OneLogin provisioning is users only, no group sync.
userName, userType and roles.value cannot be updated while a user is deactivated.
Users are provisioned with the subscription's default licence; userType changes it.

auth.notes: Scopes as listed under Required scope on each endpoint page; Company Admin role required.

capabilities.notes: Invite team members requires the user to already exist in the org; new org users come via SCIM. Team role updates only; org-level user lifecycle is SCIM.

endpoints.purpose: Invite an existing org user to a team
Bulk add/remove user group members (up to 500)
Reset all sessions of a user

okta.notes: OIN page marks SAML, SWA, SCIM and Create/Update/Deactivate/Group Push/Group Linking as checked (read from page markup).

onelogin.notes: OneLogin connector page not loaded; facts from Miro's help centre. Users only.

fallbacks.other_sync: Domain control routes new users on corporate domains into the Enterprise subscription
